_about: Every message sūveryn's server, and the appliance's web setup, sends or stores about what went wrong or what to check: a code with parameters, never a sentence (the handbook's decision of 12 November 2026, Messages are codes; docs/design/messages.md). A screen words each code in its reader's language; `title` is English, for developers, never shown to a person. A code, once released, is never renamed or reused. kind: refused | unavailable | internal | warning. A parameter's type: number | string | id; `private` marks client data, which is never logged.

system.internal.title: Something nobody planned for: a bug, a file that should be there. The log has the detail under the reference.

system.unavailable.title: A part of the server isn't available.

system.documents_unavailable.title: Document handling (search, the reader) isn't available.

auth.signed_out.title: No session, or it has ended.

auth.unavailable.title: The sign-in service can't be reached or has a problem.

request.invalid.title: The request's body or parameters aren't valid.

request.forbidden.title: The caller may not do this.

request.not_found.title: What was asked for doesn't exist, or the caller may not see it.

request.conflict.title: It can't be done in the state things are in now; the caller's view may be out of date.

request.too_large.title: What was sent is larger than accepted.

request.unsupported.title: What was sent is of a type that isn't accepted.

request.too_many.title: Too many requests from this person; `seconds` until the next is taken.

upload.unsupported_type.title: Not a file type sūveryn reads.

upload.invalid.title: The file's content doesn't fit its extension.

upload.queue_full.title: Too many documents are waiting to be read.

upload.not_zip.title: Not a ZIP archive that can be opened.

upload.archive_too_many.title: The archive holds more than `max` files.

upload.archive_too_big.title: The archive unpacks to more than `max_mb`.

upload.inbox_unavailable.title: The upload folder is missing or has the wrong permissions.

run.busy.title: Too many playbook runs are reading; start this one when one has finished.

run.already_going.title: A run of this playbook is live in this case: `run`.

run.facts_changed.title: A fact of the run changed since the state this confirmation saw; nothing was confirmed.

conversation.too_long.title: The conversation is too long to save.

user.rights_removed.title: The caller's administrator rights were removed meanwhile.

user.rights_refused.title: The sign-in service refused the gateway's administrator rights.

user.deletion_unfinished.title: An account's deletion stopped partway; deleting again finishes it.

calc.number_style.title: A calculation's figures are written in different number styles.

calc.decimal_separator.title: A calculation's figures don't show which separator is the decimal one.

setup.email_invalid.title: The administrator's email address isn't one.

setup.password_short.title: The administrator's password is shorter than `min` characters.

setup.password_common.title: The administrator's password is on the list of common passwords.

setup.password_personal.title: The administrator's password holds the name, the email address or the appliance's name.

setup.not_a_certificate.title: The file isn't a certificate in PEM format.

setup.not_a_key.title: The file isn't an unencrypted private key in PEM format.

setup.key_mismatch.title: The private key doesn't belong to the certificate.

setup.name_not_covered.title: The certificate doesn't cover the appliance's name.

setup.chain_invalid.title: The chain doesn't lead to the certificate.

setup.manifest_format.title: The file isn't a support manifest.

setup.manifest_signature.title: The support manifest isn't signed by a trusted key, or was changed after signing.

setup.manifest_other_appliance.title: The support manifest is for another appliance.

setup.share_not_local.title: The share's server isn't on the office's own network.

setup.share_unreachable.title: The appliance can't reach the share's server.

setup.disk_gone.title: The USB disk chosen isn't plugged in any more.

setup.key_invalid.title: The file holds no recovery key.

setup.not_answered.title: Provisioning was asked for before every step was answered.

setup.provisioning_started.title: Provisioning has started: answers can't change now.

setup.restore_started.title: A restore has started: answers can't change now.

setup.not_checked.title: A restore was asked for before the backup was found and checked.

setup.restore_wrong_key.title: The recovery key doesn't open the backup.

setup.restore_no_backup.title: There is no backup where the office said.

setup.restore_newer.title: The newest backup was made by a newer version than this appliance has.

setup.restore_unreachable.title: The appliance couldn't reach the disk or share with the backups.

setup.restore_failed.title: The restore stopped partway; the restore log has the detail.

setup.provisioning_failed.title: Provisioning stopped at `step`; the provisioning log has the detail.
